    result = plainText;
}
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var list=[];
var m=baseUrl.match(/tid=(\d+)/);
var tid=m?m[1]:'';
try{
var api='https://www.cool18.com/bbs4/index.php?app=forum&act=achildlist&tid='+tid;
var jsonStr=org.jsoup.Jsoup.connect(api).ignoreContentType(true).execute().body();
var json=eval('('+jsonStr+')');
var chapters=[];
for(var i=0;i<json.length;i++){if(json[i].subject.indexOf('【')===0)chapters.push(json[i])}
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var selfA=doc.createElement('a');
selfA.attr('href',baseUrl);
selfA.text('第1章');
var t=doc.select('h1').first();if(t)selfA.text(t.text())
list.push(selfA);
var base='https://www.cool18.com/bbs4/index.php?app=forum&act=threadview&tid=';
for(var i=chapters.length-1;i>=0;i--){
var a=doc.createElement('a');
a.attr('href',base+chapters[i].tid);
a.text(chapters[i].subject);
list.push(a);
}
}catch(e){
var doc=org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result);
var a=doc.createElement('a');
a.attr('href',baseUrl);
a.text('第1章');
list.push(a);
}
result=list;
</js>

    open_argument[key] = value;

    source.setVariable(result);

}

}

            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
